spec.description: Tracking plan for the RS-self (RudderStack onboarding) demo persona. Events emitted by the RudderStack dashboard application.

events.name: Account Created
events.description: Fired once when a new workspace is provisioned, immediately after email verification.

properties.name: plan
properties.description: Subscription plan at signup, e.g. free

properties.name: company
properties.description: Company name from the signup form

events.name: Source Created
events.description: Fired when a user successfully creates and saves a new source in the dashboard.

properties.name: source_type
properties.description: SDK/source type, e.g. javascript, node, ios

properties.name: source_name
properties.description: User-provided display name for the source

properties.name: elapsed_seconds_in_setup
properties.description: Total seconds spent in the setup wizard

events.name: Destination Created
events.description: Fired when a user successfully creates and saves a new destination, before any connection test.

properties.name: elapsed_seconds_in_setup
properties.description: Seconds spent in the setup wizard

events.name: Source Setup Error
events.description: Fired when an error occurs during source setup or test — e.g. write-key validation fails.

properties.name: step
properties.description: Wizard step where the error occurred

properties.name: elapsed_seconds_in_step
properties.description: Seconds spent on the failing step

events.name: Destination Setup Error
events.description: Fired when an error occurs during destination setup — e.g. credentials rejected by the downstream service.

properties.name: step
properties.description: Wizard step where the error occurred

properties.name: elapsed_seconds_in_step
properties.description: Seconds spent on the failing step

events.name: Webhook Send Error
events.description: Fired when a destination webhook delivery fails after all retries are exhausted.

properties.name: error_code
properties.description: HTTP status code or error identifier

properties.name: retry_count
properties.description: Number of delivery attempts before giving up
